candidate_tables.source: FRR 2 - Computer Aided Dispatch System Requirements.xlsx
headers: Ability to configure, by detail or sub-status type (e.g., PR event, station tour, inspection, training), whether a unit is dispatchable, dispatchable-with-warning, or not dispatchable — including a "last up" rule that automatically returns a unit on a non-emergency detail to available status when it is the last remaining resource for its district or the jurisdiction.
sample: Provide CAD-to-CAD real-time exchange of incidents, unit status, and apparatus availability with neighboring agencies, so dispatchers can view surrounding agencies' available resources directly within the CAD rather than telephoning each agency to check availability. Support electronic transmission of mutual/automatic aid requests, with resulting unit assignments and status updates returned automatically into the incident record.

Ability to clearly display all external agency units operating within the jurisdiction — including AVL location where shared — and to identify which external units are providing station fill-in or move-up coverage and to which station or district each is assigned. Ability to include mutual/automatic aid units in closest-unit recommendations where data-sharing agreements exist, and to report on aid given and aid received.

Provide a direct CAD-to-station-alerting interface (e.g., Motorola) enabling immediate automated toning upon dispatch without a separate dispatcher action, compatible with automated voice dispatching (e.g., Locution, Wavefile) generating the announcement from CAD incident data. Support zoned alerting, re-toning on demand and on dispatch of additional units, automatic redirection of alerts to the station where a relocated unit is presently housed, logging of all alerting transmissions, and graceful failover to manual voice dispatch with immediate supervisor notification. Vendor shall state the guaranteed maximum latency from dispatch commit to station alert.

candidate_tables.source: FRR 3 - Law Records Management System Requirements.xlsx
headers: Ability to automatically assign unique barcode numbers to each impounded property items based on the user identified criteria (e.g., Agency, Case/Offense Report, Unit, Item Number).
sample: Ability to associate property items to persons within the Case/Offense Report.
Ability to link to and export property detail information recorded in a report directly to an NCIC/TLETS Stolen Article, Boat, Gun, or Securities screen to avoid redundant data entry.
Ability to automatically search lost and stolen property entered into RMS against the applicable NCIC/TLETS Stolen Article, Boat, Gun, or Securities file, or vice versa.

candidate_tables.source: FRR 3 - Law Records Management System Requirements.xlsx
headers: Ability to produce the Shift Briefings by selecting the items to be added, and to annotate each item with comments as it is needed.
sample: An automated module that pulls significant incidents, BOLOs, and unit assignments from the last 24 hours into a searchable dashboard for the incoming shift.

headers: Provide authorized users with the ability to inventory and record an unlimited number of entries for property seized from inmates (e.g., quantity, description, name and ID number of the staff member receiving property, date and time).
sample: Ability to print/record a Property Receipt for signature.
Ability to add or move Property to a locker.
Ability to print/record an outside party Property Release (some or all items).
